title: How to calculate hours between two date-times
task: Elapsed hours across days — support tickets, machine uptime, shipping windows.

excel.note: A2/B2 are date+time values. Format the result as a Number, not a time.

explanation: Date-times are single numbers (days + day-fraction), so subtracting them handles day boundaries automatically: 9:00 on July 24 to 18:00 on July 25 is 1.375 days × 24 = 33 hours — no midnight special-casing needed, unlike time-only values. Divide by 24 again for days, multiply by 60 for minutes. This is why storing timestamps as real date-times (not separate date and time columns) pays off.
